run_paged_memcpy_benchmark: run the paged_memcpy benchmark script to measure GPU memory copy throughput across batch sizes and sequence lengths
test_paged_memcpy_correctness: test the paged_memcpy kernel by verifying source and destination tensors match after the copy operation
benchmark_paged_memcpy_vs_copy: benchmark paged_memcpy performance against standard torch copy_ using CUDA graphs and timing events
run_cuda_graph_benchmark: run a CUDA graph-based benchmark that measures paged_memcpy latency over multiple iterations
measure_gpu_memory_throughput: measure GPU memory throughput in GB/s for paged memory copy operations with varying batch and sequence sizes
